Next.js 15 App Router customer portal. Work ONLY in the git worktree /opt/nxeon-wt-mktg (NOT /opt/nxeon). Do NOT run git/npm build/prisma — edit files only.

A hero component exists: components/portal/PortalHero.tsx — read it. It's a drop-in with props `title` (ReactNode), `sub?` (string), `children` (optional right-side actions), and `variant` (string picking a page illustration + accent). Signature: `<PortalHero variant="mail" title="Inbox" sub="..." />`. Supported variants include: mail, email, sites, calendar, build, matrix, and many others (see the GLYPHS/VARIANT_ACCENT maps in the file — if a variant isn't listed it falls back cleanly to the dashboard glyph, which is fine).

GOAL: 5 portal pages currently have NO hero because they delegate their whole body to a client component. Add a PortalHero at the TOP of each, ABOVE the delegated client component, WITHOUT creating a duplicate title. For each page:
1. app/dashboard/mail/page.tsx — delegates to MailClient. variant="mail", title="Inbox", sub="Read and send from your Nxeon mailboxes." NOTE: the Inbox is a full webmail app UI — if adding a hero would clearly break a full-height/scroll layout, add it but keep it above the app region; if MailClient renders its own top chrome/title, DO NOT duplicate — instead skip and report. There are multiple `return (` branches (unavailable states + the main one) — add the hero to the MAIN success return at least.
2. app/dashboard/sites/page.tsx — delegates to SitesManager. FIRST read components/customer/site-builder/SitesManager.tsx: it appears to render its OWN header/title. If so, DO NOT add a page-level hero (would duplicate) — instead add `<PortalHero variant="sites" title="Website builder" sub="..."/>` ONLY if SitesManager has no title; otherwise SKIP and report. (feature-flagged off by default, low risk either way.)
3. app/dashboard/calendar/page.tsx — delegates to CalendarClient (no own title). variant="calendar", title="Calendar", sub="Your schedule, events, and tasks." Add to the main success return.
4. app/dashboard/claude-code/page.tsx — delegates to ClaudeCodeHub which renders its OWN header (confirm by reading components/customer/claude-code/ClaudeCodeHub.tsx). If it has its own title, SKIP the page-level hero and report (don't duplicate). If you can cleanly pass a hero without duplication, use variant="build", title="Build with AI".
5. app/dashboard/build/page.tsx — this is a thin placeholder (`return <div className="min-h-[60vh]" aria-hidden />`) painted by a portal-level provider. Adding a hero here likely won't render usefully — inspect; if it's genuinely just a placeholder, SKIP and report. Otherwise variant="matrix", title="Matrix".

RULES: import `import { PortalHero } from "@/components/portal/PortalHero";` where you add it. Wrap the existing returned element in a fragment: `return (<><PortalHero .../>{existing}</>)`. Preserve all existing logic, props, and conditional-return branches. Where a page's client component already shows its own big title, SKIP that page and report it (do NOT create duplicate headers). Edit ONLY these 5 page.tsx files (and READ the client components to decide). Do NOT edit PortalHero.tsx or anything else.

REPORT (concise): for each of the 5 pages — added (with variant) or skipped (why: own-title / placeholder / layout). Confirm no duplicate titles introduced.
